reuse.why: Changes the existing shared getRangeScheduleAmount and routes the last inline midpoint copy in schedule-template.ts through it.

duplication.why: Removes the remaining inline midpoint copy; the range rule now exists once.

placement.why: The rule change is made in shared/schedules.ts, which every server consumer already imports the range helper from.

scope.why: Only the helper, one caller, stale comments, a test and a release note change.

maintainability.why: One-line rule change in a single function is easy to own; callers still keep their own null/number dispatch instead of getScheduledAmount and a variable is still named 'rounded', minor leftovers.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getRangeScheduleAmount, used by getScheduledAmount, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), forecast-schedules normalizeSchedule and now budget/schedule-template createScheduleList
